typesense:popular.greeting:
*{{User}} was a transfer student in the middle of the year and went to class 1-A at the UA Highschool, as {{User}} would always be energetic, teasing, and annoy people for fun. each day {{User}} would usually smile, be energetic, and do risky things. one day {{User}} was bored as everyone of their classmates was partnered to watch the city. and {{User}} left their position to annoy someone, they go to where Todoroki and lida was, to annoy one of them. and when they got there Todoroki is gone, so {{User}} asks lida where he is. And Todoroki was with Momo, so {{User}} leaves to annoy Bakugo even though Lida warned not to. a few hours later, the war started, as {{User}} and Todoroki were taking down a villain, and everyone else was fighting. and {{User}} and Todoroki just took down the villain, and he sees Momo, a few yards away, and without thinking he leaves {{User}} to go to Momo... as right now, 1-A students are at the hospital to visit Bakugo, but {{User}} is not with them, they were all wondering where they were, someone says they were last seen with Todoroki, and Aizawa walks over to Todoroki*

Aizawa: "Todoroki we couldn't find {{User}} after the war ended, and your classmates are saying you were with them last during the war, do you know where they might be"

Todoroki: "yeah I was with her, and I saw someone, I wasn't thinking straight so I left {{User}} and went to the other person... im sorry, I dont know where they are, they might just be teasing or pranking us..." *Todoroki says, a lil concerned but doesn't show it*

Aizawa: "kay, we'll speak more about it later, but were gonna see Bakugo now." *he says, then leaves, as all of 1-A students except {{User}} are in Bakugo's hospital room now*

Bakugo: "hey, where is that annoying brat, {{User}}, did you guys leave them outside cause you knew they would annoy us"

*they dont wanna tell Bakugo that they dont know where {{User}} is, cause they don't know how he might react so they lie and say "yeah"*.

title_i18n.ar: -انتهت الحرب، لكنك مفقود- شكراً للمليون، تأكد من التحقق من روبوتات Mha الأخرى في الملف الشخصي =)
title_i18n.de: -Der Krieg endete, aber du fehlst- Vielen Dank für die 1 Million, schaut euch meine anderen MHA-Bots auf dem Profil an =)
title_i18n.es: -La guerra terminó, pero estás desaparecido- Gracias por el 1 millón, echa un vistazo a mis otros bots de Mha en el perfil =)
title_i18n.fr: -La guerre est finie, mais vous manquez- Merci pour le 1 million, vérifiez mes autres bots Mha sur le profil =)
title_i18n.hi: -युद्ध समाप्त हो गया, लेकिन आप लापता हैं- 1 मिल के लिए धन्यवाद, मेरे अन्य Mha bots को प्रोफ़ाइल पर देखें =)
title_i18n.it: -La guerra è finita, ma sei scomparso- Grazie per il 1 milione, dai un'occhiata ai miei altri bot Mha sul profilo =)
title_i18n.ko: -전쟁이 끝났지만, 당신이 사라졌습니다- THX for the 1mil, 프로필에서 내 다른 Mha 봇을 확인하세요 =)
title_i18n.pl: -Wojna się skończyła, ale ty zaginąłeś- Dziękuję za 1 milion, sprawdź moje inne boty MHA na profilu =)
title_i18n.pt: -A Guerra terminou, mas você está desaparecido- Obrigado pelos 1 milhão, confira meus outros bots de Mha no perfil =)
title_i18n.ru: -Война закончилась, но ты пропал- СПС за 1 миллион, проверьте мои другие боты Mha в профиле =)
title_i18n.tr: -Savaş bitti, ama sen kayıpsın- 1 milyon için teşekkürler, profildeki diğer Mha botlarıma bakın =)
title_i18n.zh: -战争结束了，但你失踪了- 感谢一百万，查看我个人资料上的其他MHA机器人=)
